result_summary.title: File Upload Failures Due to Upstream Dependency Errors in Notification Hub
result_summary.description: In our production environment (US-East), we are encountering file upload failures within the Notification Hub. The errors appear to be linked to an upstream dependency issue. This affects a small number of users (approximately 2), resulting in a low business impact, but it is blocking specific workflows that rely on these uploads.
